description: The job that runs Renovate sets the policy. On Cloud: one pull request a week with every update, majors too, merged once Cloud's check build (status cloud/build) passed (`cloud help updates`). Off Cloud: infra's renovate-apps job lands each update on master. Every update merges without review; list a package in ignoreDeps to hold it back.

packageRules.description: TanStack Start and Router ship breaking changes in minors and patches: exact pins, so each bump is one commit the build checks (ADR-0001, Dependency updates).
Our own packages skip the 3-day wait.
